text:
Alex: Heads up — PR #9147 (kv cache OOM fix) is ready; CI is green. Need a second signoff before cutoff at 12:30 PT (~45m). Anyone able to LGTM? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9147
Priya: Quick question — did we bump the mem alloc flag? The diff looked tiny.
Alex: yeah added `--kv-cache-size=0.6` fallback and a safeguard. Tested locally, no perf regressions on smoke.
Jonah: I can take a look in ~10; leaving a meeting now. If it's quick I can give a +1.
Maria: staging smoke ran and passed; saw one flaky in `lr_scheduler_test` earlier — unrelated to this change.
Priya: @Jonah if you're looking, can you also eyeball `infra/rollouts.yml` entry? want to ensure no unexpected burst config.
Jonah: quick sweep done, left an inline nit about log level (non-blocking). overall LGTM from infra.
Alex: great, thanks! we still need one more signoff. @Priya can you do the second? otherwise anyone on call?
Priya: will do a quick pass now, give me 5.
Priya: LGTM — nit is the log level but not a blocker for this hotfix.
release-bot: Cutoff scheduled for 12:30 PT. Current time is t-minus 18m.
Alex: merging in 2 — tagging release and kicking the pipeline. :rocket:
release-bot: Merged PR #9147 (author: Alex) — deploy pipeline triggered (build #8712).
QA-bot: Staging smoke checks OK. Monitoring for 15m post-merge.
Jonah: I'll watch traces for kv-cache latency; ping me if we see spikes.
Alex: thanks all — closing this thread after monitoring window.
